narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote LIP Intimate Care products by addressing common feminine hygiene issues such as dryness and irritation. The creator uses a mix of personal storytelling, stock footage examples, and direct product demonstrations to establish trust and illustrate the benefits of oil-based intimate care over traditional cleansers.
